title: Exercise 2: Context File Experiment
description: Six commands run the same task twice in the same directory: first without a context file, then after creating a CLAUDE.md starter from Section 3, saving both transcripts for side-by-side comparison.

steps.description: The sequence creates a directory, runs claude and saves transcript-no-context.txt, creates the CLAUDE.md context file, runs claude again and saves transcript-with-context.txt, then compares them.
Line 4 instructs you to create the CLAUDE.md file with the starter content from Section 3, adapted to your actual task.

steps.question: What is the success criterion for this exercise?
steps.answer: quote two specific lines (one from each transcript) showing a concrete difference in agent behavior attributable to the context file
